def regexr_transform(column):
    for value in column:
        # Convert the date string to YYYY-MM-DD format
        if re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', value) is None:
            # If the date is not already in the desired format, convert it
            match = re.search(r'(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4})', value)
            if match:
                year = int(match.group(3))
                month = int(match.group(1))
                day = int(match.group(2))
                formatted_date = f"{year}-{month}-{day}"
                value = formatted_date
        column[column.index(value)] = value
    return column
